high_level_description: The image shows a person taking a mirror selfie in what appears to be a hotel room. The individual is wearing a snakeskin-patterned bikini, consisting of a matching top and bottom. They are holding a yellow smartphone with their right hand, which is raised to take the photo. The background reveals a neatly made bed with white bedding and a gray headboard. There is a pair of sunglasses placed on the bed near the foot. To the right of the bed, there is a small table or nightstand with a red quilted bag and a vase containing white flowers.
